subhero.en: Medicare Part D places generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) and generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) on Tier 1 or Tier 2 of nearly every 2026 formulary, with copays running $0 to $10 a month. Cash prices for the same generics run $3 to $18 a month at major pharmacy chains without any insurance at all. Brand-name Lipitor and Crestor, by contrast, cost $300 to $700 a month at retail and sit on higher formulary tiers when a Part D plan still lists them. Neither drug is subject to Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation because both are already inexpensive generics. This page breaks down 2026 Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage statin copays by tier, cash pharmacy prices, dual-eligible Extra Help rates, and manufacturer patient assistance programs for patients who genuinely need the brand.
subhero.es: Medicare Parte D coloca la atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) y la rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) en el Nivel 1 o Nivel 2 de casi todos los formularios de 2026, con copagos de $0 a $10 al mes. Los precios en efectivo de los mismos genericos son de $3 a $18 al mes en las principales cadenas de farmacias sin ningun seguro. Lipitor y Crestor de marca, en cambio, cuestan $300 a $700 al mes al por menor. Ninguno de los dos esta sujeto a la negociacion de precios de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion porque ambos ya son genericos economicos. Esta pagina desglosa los copagos de Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage por nivel en 2026, precios de farmacia en efectivo, tarifas de Ayuda Extra para doble elegibles y programas de asistencia al paciente del fabricante.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage prescription drug plans place generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) and generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) on Tier 1 or Tier 2, with typical copays of $0 to $10 for a 30-day supply. Without insurance, the same generics cost $3 to $18 a month at Costco, Walmart, Kroger, CVS, and Walgreens. Brand-name Lipitor and Crestor retail for $300 to $700 a month and are not selected for Inflation Reduction Act Maximum Fair Price negotiation because generics already exist. Statin spending counts toward the 2026 Medicare Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100, though most beneficiaries never come close to that cap from statins alone. Dual-eligible beneficiaries enrolled in Medicare Extra Help typically pay $0 to $4.90 per statin fill. Patients who specifically need brand Lipitor or brand Crestor can apply to Pfizer RxPathways or AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program if household income is at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, los planes de Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage colocan la atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) y la rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) en el Nivel 1 o Nivel 2, con copagos tipicos de $0 a $10 por un suministro de 30 dias. Sin seguro, los mismos genericos cuestan $3 a $18 al mes en Costco, Walmart, Kroger, CVS y Walgreens. Lipitor y Crestor de marca se venden al por menor entre $300 y $700 al mes y no fueron seleccionados para la negociacion del Precio Justo Maximo de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion porque ya existen genericos. El gasto en estatinas cuenta para el limite anual de bolsillo de Medicare Parte D de $2,100 en 2026. Los beneficiarios de doble elegibilidad inscritos en Ayuda Extra de Medicare tipicamente pagan $0 a $4.90 por receta de estatina.

introParagraphs.en: Medicare beneficiaries taking a statin in 2026 are almost always prescribed one of two generics: atorvastatin (brand name Lipitor) or rosuvastatin (brand name Crestor). Both molecules lost patent protection years ago, atorvastatin in November 2011 and rosuvastatin in 2016, and both are now manufactured by more than a dozen FDA-approved generic makers. Because of that competition, every Medicare Part D standalone prescription drug plan (PDP) and every Medicare Advantage prescription drug plan (MAPD) places generic atorvastatin and generic rosuvastatin on its lowest formulary tiers, Tier 1 (preferred generic) or Tier 2 (generic), for 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Los beneficiarios de Medicare que toman una estatina en 2026 casi siempre reciben uno de dos genericos: atorvastatina (nombre comercial Lipitor) o rosuvastatina (nombre comercial Crestor). Ambas moleculas perdieron la proteccion de patente hace anos, la atorvastatina en noviembre de 2011 y la rosuvastatina en 2016, y ambas son fabricadas ahora por mas de una docena de fabricantes genericos aprobados por la FDA. Debido a esa competencia, todos los planes de Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage colocan la atorvastatina y la rosuvastatina genericas en sus niveles mas bajos del formulario para 2026.

introParagraphs.en: Tier placement translates directly into copay amounts. A Tier 1 preferred generic copay on most 2026 Part D plans runs $0 to $5 for a 30-day supply, and a Tier 2 generic copay runs $5 to $10. Brand-name Lipitor and Crestor, when a plan still carries them at all, usually sit on Tier 3 (preferred brand) or higher, with copays or coinsurance far above the generic rate. Patients who fill a brand-name statin without checking their plan's tier first are frequently the ones who end up disputing an unexpectedly high pharmacy bill. Reviewing your plan's 2026 formulary through the Medicare Plan Finder at medicare.gov before your annual enrollment period ends is the single most effective way to confirm which tier your statin sits on.
introParagraphs.es: La ubicacion del nivel se traduce directamente en el monto del copago. Un copago de generico preferido de Nivel 1 en la mayoria de los planes Parte D de 2026 es de $0 a $5 por un suministro de 30 dias, y un copago de generico de Nivel 2 es de $5 a $10. Lipitor y Crestor de marca, cuando un plan todavia los incluye, generalmente estan en el Nivel 3 (marca preferida) o superior, con copagos mucho mas altos que la tarifa generica. Revisar el formulario 2026 de su plan a traves del Buscador de Planes de Medicare en medicare.gov antes de que termine su periodo de inscripcion anual es la forma mas efectiva de confirmar en que nivel esta su estatina.

introParagraphs.en: Neither atorvastatin nor rosuvastatin appears on the list of drugs selected for Medicare price negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, and neither has a negotiated Maximum Fair Price for 2026. CMS selects negotiation candidates from single-source brand-name drugs with the highest total Medicare Part D spending and no generic competition. Because atorvastatin and rosuvastatin already have robust generic markets driving prices down to $3 to $18 a month, they do not meet the negotiation criteria and do not need to. All statin spending, whether generic or brand, still counts toward the 2026 Medicare Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 set by the same law. For readers comparing this page against the broader class overview, see the [statins cost comparison](/en/drug/statins-cost-comparison) page and the standalone [atorvastatin cost](/en/drug/atorvastatin-cost) breakdown.
introParagraphs.es: Ni la atorvastatina ni la rosuvastatina aparecen en la lista de medicamentos seleccionados para la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, y ninguna tiene un Precio Justo Maximo negociado para 2026. CMS selecciona candidatos a negociacion entre medicamentos de marca de fuente unica con el mayor gasto total de Medicare Parte D y sin competencia generica. Debido a que la atorvastatina y la rosuvastatina ya tienen mercados genericos solidos que reducen los precios a $3 a $18 al mes, no cumplen los criterios de negociacion. Todo el gasto en estatinas, generico o de marca, cuenta para el limite anual de bolsillo de Medicare Parte D de $2,100 de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Hospital pharmacies bill oral medications, including statins, at facility rates that bundle drug acquisition cost with nursing administration, pharmacy dispensing, storage, and overhead. A generic atorvastatin tablet that a hospital pharmacy acquires for under $0.50 can appear on an itemized inpatient bill at $50 to $300 per dose. A Medicare beneficiary admitted for a cardiac procedure who continues a daily statin during a 4-day stay can see $200 to $1,200 in statin charges on the itemized bill, for a medication that costs $3 to $18 a month at any retail pharmacy.
paragraphs.es: Las farmacias hospitalarias facturan medicamentos orales, incluidas las estatinas, a tarifas de instalacion que incluyen el costo de adquisicion mas administracion de enfermeria, dispensacion de farmacia, almacenamiento y gastos generales. Una tableta de atorvastatina generica que una farmacia hospitalaria adquiere por menos de $0.50 puede aparecer en una factura hospitalaria detallada a $50 a $300 por dosis.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part A covers the inpatient stay and its drugs under the hospital's diagnosis-related group (DRG) payment, so the statin's inflated line-item charge does not usually generate a separate patient bill for Medicare beneficiaries without a Part A deductible or coinsurance liability tied to the stay itself. The itemized statin charge still matters for patients disputing a facility's total billed charges, for beneficiaries with a Medicare Advantage plan applying per-day copays, and for anyone reviewing a hospital bill for accuracy. Requesting the itemized bill and the National Drug Code (NDC) for each statin line is the fastest way to verify the charge against the drug's known retail price.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte A cubre la hospitalizacion y sus medicamentos bajo el pago del grupo relacionado con el diagnostico (DRG) del hospital, por lo que el cargo inflado de la estatina por linea generalmente no genera una factura separada para los beneficiarios de Medicare. Solicitar la factura detallada y el Codigo Nacional de Medicamento (NDC) para cada linea de estatina es la forma mas rapida de verificar el cargo contra el precio minorista conocido del medicamento.

intro.en: Pfizer (maker of brand Lipitor) and AstraZeneca (maker of brand Crestor) both run manufacturer patient assistance programs available to Medicare beneficiaries who cannot afford the brand-name product and have a documented clinical reason they cannot switch to the generic. Most Medicare beneficiaries never need a PAP for a statin because generic atorvastatin and rosuvastatin already carry a $0 to $10 Part D copay or a $3 to $18 cash price.
intro.es: Pfizer (fabricante de Lipitor de marca) y AstraZeneca (fabricante de Crestor de marca) administran programas de asistencia al paciente disponibles para beneficiarios de Medicare que no pueden pagar el producto de marca y tienen una razon clinica documentada por la que no pueden cambiar al generico. La mayoria de los beneficiarios de Medicare nunca necesitan un PAP para una estatina porque la atorvastatina y rosuvastatina genericas ya tienen un copago Parte D de $0 a $10 o un precio en efectivo de $3 a $18.

footnote.en: Manufacturer savings cards and coupons are blocked by federal anti-kickback statute (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) for anyone enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA benefits. Medicare beneficiaries cannot use a Lipitor or Crestor manufacturer coupon at the pharmacy counter. Use the income-based Pfizer RxPathways or AZ&Me patient assistance program instead, or ask your Part D plan to apply the Extra Help low-income subsidy if you qualify.

Seccion 1320a-7b) para cualquier persona inscrita en Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. Los beneficiarios de Medicare no pueden usar un cupon del fabricante de Lipitor o Crestor en el mostrador de la farmacia. Utilice el PAP basado en ingresos de Pfizer RxPathways o AZ&Me en su lugar.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage prescription drug plans place generic atorvastatin and generic rosuvastatin on Tier 1 (preferred generic) or Tier 2 (generic) on virtually every 2026 formulary, with copays of $0 to $10 for a 30-day supply. There is no statin-specific monthly cap under the Inflation Reduction Act, unlike the $35 insulin cap. Instead, statin costs count toward the general 2026 Medicare Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100, after which a beneficiary pays $0 for all covered drugs for the rest of the calendar year. Because generic statins are so inexpensive, reaching the $2,100 cap from statin spending alone is essentially impossible.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage colocan la atorvastatina y rosuvastatina genericas en el Nivel 1 (generico preferido) o Nivel 2 (generico) en practicamente todos los formularios de 2026, con copagos de $0 a $10 por un suministro de 30 dias. No hay un limite mensual especifico para estatinas bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. En cambio, los costos de estatinas cuentan para el limite anual general de Medicare Parte D de $2,100 en 2026.

paragraphs.en: CMS did not select atorvastatin or rosuvastatin for Inflation Reduction Act Medicare price negotiation, and neither drug has a Maximum Fair Price for 2026. The negotiation program targets single-source brand drugs with high total Medicare spending and no generic competition, such as Eliquis and Jardiance. Statins already have robust generic competition driving cash prices to $3 to $18 a month, so a negotiated price would add no additional savings. Brand-name Lipitor and Crestor remain on some formularies as Tier 3 or Tier 4 drugs at far higher cost, but no Medicare beneficiary needs to pay that price when the bioequivalent generic is available at a fraction of the cost.
paragraphs.es: CMS no selecciono la atorvastatina ni la rosuvastatina para la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, y ninguno de los dos medicamentos tiene un Precio Justo Maximo para 2026. El programa de negociacion se dirige a medicamentos de marca de fuente unica con alto gasto total de Medicare y sin competencia generica, como Eliquis y Jardiance. Las estatinas ya tienen una competencia generica solida que reduce los precios en efectivo a $3 a $18 al mes.

paragraphs.en: Dual-eligible Medicare beneficiaries, meaning those who also qualify for Medicaid, and beneficiaries approved for the Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) program typically pay $0 to $4.90 for a generic statin fill in 2026. Extra Help applications go through the Social Security Administration at ssa.gov/extrahelp or a local Social Security office, and most applicants who qualify for full Extra Help pay nothing at all for a generic statin for the rest of the plan year. Beneficiaries choosing between a standalone Part D plan and a Medicare Advantage plan during the October 15 to December 7 open enrollment window should compare each plan's specific statin tier placement using the Medicare Plan Finder before enrolling, since tier placement can shift year to year.
paragraphs.es: Los beneficiarios de Medicare con doble elegibilidad, es decir, quienes tambien califican para Medicaid, y los beneficiarios aprobados para Ayuda Extra tipicamente pagan $0 a $4.90 por una receta de estatina generica en 2026. Las solicitudes de Ayuda Extra se hacen a traves de la Administracion del Seguro Social en ssa.gov/extrahelp. La mayoria de los solicitantes que califican para Ayuda Extra completa no pagan nada por una estatina generica durante el resto del ano del plan.

intro.en: If your Part D plan charges more than $10 for a generic statin, or your hospital bill shows $50 or more per statin tablet, check for these common billing errors before paying:
intro.es: Si su plan Parte D cobra mas de $10 por una estatina generica, o su factura hospitalaria muestra $50 o mas por tableta de estatina, verifique estos errores comunes antes de pagar:

items.en: Brand-name Lipitor or Crestor billed to Part D when the pharmacy actually dispensed the generic: this can inflate your copay to the Tier 3 brand rate instead of the Tier 1 generic rate. Confirm the NDC on your receipt matches the generic manufacturer.
items.es: Lipitor o Crestor de marca facturado a Parte D cuando la farmacia en realidad dispenso el generico: esto puede inflar su copago a la tarifa de marca de Nivel 3. Confirme que el NDC en su recibo coincide con el fabricante generico.

items.en: Wrong formulary tier applied at the pharmacy: if your explanation of benefits shows a Tier 3 copay for a drug that should be Tier 1, ask the pharmacist to reprocess the claim with the correct National Drug Code.
items.es: Nivel de formulario incorrecto aplicado en la farmacia: si su explicacion de beneficios muestra un copago de Nivel 3 para un medicamento que deberia ser Nivel 1, pida al farmaceutico que reprocese el reclamo.

items.en: Extra Help subsidy not applied even though you are approved: dual-eligible and full-subsidy beneficiaries should never pay more than $4.90 for a generic statin in 2026. If your receipt shows a higher amount, ask the pharmacy to verify your Low-Income Subsidy status with the plan.
items.es: Subsidio de Ayuda Extra no aplicado aunque este aprobado: los beneficiarios de doble elegibilidad no deberian pagar mas de $4.90 por una estatina generica en 2026. Pida a la farmacia que verifique su estado de Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos.

items.en: Inpatient charge for a dose that was clinically held: statins are sometimes held before a procedure or during a restricted diet order. A held dose still appearing as a billed charge is a standard dispute item.
items.es: Cargo hospitalario por una dosis retenida clinicamente: las estatinas a veces se retienen antes de un procedimiento. Una dosis retenida que aun aparece como cargo facturado es un objetivo estandar de disputa.

items.en: Prior authorization denial not appealed on a Medicare Advantage plan: generic statin denials are rare, but if one occurs, request a written coverage determination and ask your prescriber to file a redetermination request within 60 days.
items.es: Denegacion de autorizacion previa no apelada en un plan Medicare Advantage: las denegaciones de estatinas genericas son raras, pero si ocurren, solicite una determinacion de cobertura por escrito y pida a su medico que presente una redeterminacion dentro de 60 dias.

notes.en: Costco frequently posts the lowest generic atorvastatin cash price in the country at around $3 for a 30-day supply. Rosuvastatin runs higher, near $10 to $12. Costco pharmacy sells to non-members for prescriptions in most states.
notes.es: Costco frecuentemente publica el precio en efectivo mas bajo de atorvastatina generica en el pais, alrededor de $3 por suministro de 30 dias. La rosuvastatina cuesta mas, cerca de $10 a $12.

notes.es: Un cupon GoodRx gratuito o la membresia anual del Kroger Rx Savings Club lleva ambos genericos de estatinas por debajo de $12 por suministro de 30 dias.

notes.es: Se requiere un cupon gratuito en goodrx.com para llegar al extremo inferior. Sin cupon, los precios en efectivo en CVS pueden llegar a $50 a $100 al mes.

note.en: Both major statins covered on this page are already generic. Atorvastatin (Lipitor) has been generic since November 2011, and rosuvastatin (Crestor) has been generic since 2016. More than a dozen FDA-approved manufacturers produce each generic as of 2026. Statins are small-molecule synthetic drugs, not biologics, so no biosimilar pathway applies to any statin. A Medicare beneficiary prescribed brand-name Lipitor or Crestor should ask the prescriber whether the generic is clinically appropriate before paying the higher brand-tier copay.
note.es: Ambas estatinas principales cubiertas en esta pagina ya son genericas. La atorvastatina (Lipitor) es generica desde noviembre de 2011, y la rosuvastatina (Crestor) es generica desde 2016. Mas de una docena de fabricantes aprobados por la FDA producen cada generico a partir de 2026. Las estatinas son farmacos sinteticos de molecula pequena, no biologicos, por lo que no aplica ninguna via de biosimilares a ninguna estatina.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written coverage determination or Explanation of Benefits from your Medicare Part D or Medicare Advantage plan stating the exact denial reason, such as non-formulary status, quantity limit, or step-therapy requirement.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite una determinacion de cobertura por escrito de su plan Medicare Parte D o Medicare Advantage indicando el motivo exacto de la denegacion.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: Ask your prescriber to file a formulary exception or prior authorization request documenting why the prescribed statin is clinically necessary. Most generic statin exceptions for standard cardiovascular doses are approved within 72 hours.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Pida a su medico que presente una excepcion de formulario o solicitud de autorizacion previa documentando por que la estatina recetada es clinicamente necesaria.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: If denied, file a Level 1 redetermination request with your plan within 60 days of the denial notice. If that is denied, request a Level 2 Independent Review Entity (IRE) reconsideration through CMS.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Si se niega, presente una solicitud de redeterminacion de Nivel 1 con su plan dentro de 60 dias del aviso de denegacion. Si se niega, solicite una reconsideracion de la Entidad de Revision Independiente (IRE) a traves de CMS.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: Escalate to an Administrative Law Judge hearing if the IRE denies your case and the disputed amount meets the minimum threshold for 2026. Call 1-800-MEDICARE for guidance on filing the next-level appeal.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Escale a una audiencia con un Juez de Derecho Administrativo si la IRE niega su caso. Llame al 1-800-MEDICARE para orientacion sobre la presentacion de la siguiente apelacion.

stepTherapyOverride.en: Some Medicare Advantage plans require a beneficiary to try a lower-cost statin, such as simvastatin or pravastatin, before covering atorvastatin or rosuvastatin at a higher formulary tier under step therapy. Your prescriber can file a step-therapy override documenting that the required statin caused a side effect, drug interaction, or failed to reach your LDL cholesterol target. Properly documented statin step-therapy overrides are typically approved within 72 hours.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Algunos planes Medicare Advantage requieren que un beneficiario pruebe una estatina de menor costo, como simvastatina o pravastatina, antes de cubrir atorvastatina o rosuvastatina en un nivel superior bajo terapia escalonada. Su medico puede presentar una anulacion de terapia escalonada documentando efectos secundarios o interacciones.

papFallback.en: Medicare beneficiaries who need the brand-name product for a documented clinical reason and cannot afford the Part D brand-tier copay should apply to Pfizer RxPathways (Lipitor) or AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program (Crestor). Both accept Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage enrollees at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level. For most beneficiaries, switching to the generic while the appeal is pending provides immediate access at a $0 to $10 copay.
papFallback.es: Los beneficiarios de Medicare que necesitan el producto de marca por una razon clinica documentada y no pueden pagar el copago de nivel de marca de Parte D deben solicitar a Pfizer RxPathways (Lipitor) o al programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca (Crestor). Ambos aceptan a inscritos de Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza o menos.

genericAlternative.en: Generic alternative: FDA-approved bioequivalent generic atorvastatin and rosuvastatin are available on Tier 1 or Tier 2 of nearly every 2026 Medicare formulary at $0 to $10 a month, and for $3 to $18 in cash without insurance at all. Discuss with your prescriber whether switching from a brand-name statin to its generic, or to a different generic statin, meets your LDL cholesterol target before pursuing a lengthy appeal.
genericAlternative.es: Alternativa generica: la atorvastatina y rosuvastatina genericas bioequivalentes aprobadas por la FDA estan disponibles en el Nivel 1 o 2 de casi todos los formularios de Medicare 2026 a $0 a $10 al mes. Discuta con su medico si cambiar a un generico cumple con su objetivo de colesterol LDL antes de iniciar una apelacion prolongada.

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Confirm with your prescriber that generic atorvastatin or rosuvastatin is not clinically appropriate for you. Most Medicare beneficiaries can switch to the generic at a $0 to $10 Part D copay and skip the PAP application entirely.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Confirme con su medico que la atorvastatina o rosuvastatina generica no es clinicamente apropiada para usted. La mayoria de los beneficiarios de Medicare pueden cambiar al generico con un copago Parte D de $0 a $10.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: For Lipitor, visit pfizerrxpathways.com or call 1-844-989-PATH (7284). For Crestor, visit azandme.com or call 1-800-AZandMe (1-800-292-6363). Both programs explicitly accept Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage enrollees.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Para Lipitor, visite pfizerrxpathways.com o llame al 1-844-989-PATH (7284). Para Crestor, visite azandme.com o llame al 1-800-AZandMe (1-800-292-6363).

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather documents: most recent federal tax return or 4 consecutive pay stubs, proof of US residency, a valid brand-name prescription, and proof of Medicare Part D or Medicare Advantage enrollment showing you are unable to afford the copay.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reuna documentos: declaracion de impuestos federales mas reciente o 4 talonarios de pago, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida de marca y prueba de inscripcion en Medicare Parte D o Medicare Advantage.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Complete the online enrollment or fax the signed patient application with your prescriber's signature. AZ&Me fax number is 1-877-239-0867; Pfizer applications can be submitted online through Pfizer PAP Connect.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Complete la inscripcion en linea o envie por fax la solicitud firmada del paciente con la firma de su medico. El numero de fax de AZ&Me es 1-877-239-0867.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: Processing typically takes 7 to 14 business days. If approved, the brand medication ships directly to your home or your prescriber's office at no charge. Annual renewal is required for both programs.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: El procesamiento generalmente toma de 7 a 14 dias habiles. Si se aprueba, el medicamento de marca se envia directamente a su hogar sin cargo. Se requiere renovacion anual.

en.question: How much does a statin cost on Medicare in 2026?
en.answer: Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) and generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) sit on Tier 1 or Tier 2 of nearly every 2026 Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage formulary, with copays running $0 to $10 for a 30-day supply. Dual-eligible beneficiaries on Extra Help pay $0 to $4.90. Brand-name Lipitor or Crestor, if your plan still covers them, sit on a higher tier with a copay well above the generic rate. All statin costs count toward the 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100.

en.question: Is there a generic for Lipitor and Crestor?
en.answer: Yes. Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) has been available since November 2011, and generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) has been available since 2016. More than a dozen FDA-approved manufacturers produce each generic as of 2026. There are no biosimilars for either drug because statins are small-molecule synthetic drugs, not biologics. Medicare Part D places both generics on its lowest formulary tiers, making the brand-name version unnecessary for most beneficiaries.

en.question: How do I apply for the patient assistance program for brand-name Lipitor or Crestor?
en.answer: For Lipitor, apply through Pfizer RxPathways at pfizerrxpathways.com or call 1-844-989-PATH (7284). For Crestor, apply through AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program at azandme.com or call 1-800-292-6363. Both accept Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage enrollees with household income at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level. Processing takes 7 to 14 business days. Most Medicare patients can skip the PAP entirely by switching to the $0 to $10 generic copay instead.

en.question: Can I use a Lipitor or Crestor manufacturer coupon with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback statute (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars manufacturer copay coupons from being used by anyone enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA benefits. Manufacturer coupons for brand Lipitor and Crestor are restricted to commercially insured patients only. If you are on Medicare and need help affording a statin, apply for Medicare Extra Help through the Social Security Administration or use the income-based Pfizer RxPathways or AZ&Me patient assistance program.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated Medicare price apply to statins?
en.answer: No. Neither atorvastatin nor rosuvastatin was selected for Inflation Reduction Act Medicare price negotiation, and neither has a Maximum Fair Price for 2026. CMS selects negotiation candidates from brand-name drugs with high Medicare spending and no generic competition, such as Eliquis and Jardiance. Statins already have generic competition holding prices to $3 to $18 a month, so no negotiation was necessary. All Part D drug spending, statins included, still falls under the general 2026 annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100.

en.question: What does a statin cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter?
en.answer: Generic atorvastatin costs $3 to $9 a month at Costco and Walmart without insurance, and $10 to $25 at CVS or Walgreens with a free coupon. Generic rosuvastatin runs $9 to $18 a month at most major chains with a coupon. Brand-name Lipitor and Crestor retail for $300 to $700 a month without insurance. Anyone paying more than $25 a month for a generic statin should show the pharmacist a free GoodRx coupon before paying cash.

en.question: What if my Medicare plan denies coverage for my statin?
en.answer: Generic statin denials on Medicare are rare because nearly every Part D and Medicare Advantage plan covers at least two statins on Tier 1. If denied, request a written coverage determination, then ask your prescriber to file a formulary exception or prior authorization documenting clinical necessity. If still denied, file a Level 1 redetermination within 60 days, then escalate to an Independent Review Entity. Switching to the covered generic provides immediate access while an appeal is pending.

en.question: Do I qualify for the Pfizer RxPathways or AZ&Me patient assistance program?
en.answer: To qualify in 2026, your household income must be at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level: $47,880 for one person, $99,000 for a family of four. You also need a valid brand-name prescription, Medicare Part D or Medicare Advantage enrollment (or no insurance), and a documented reason the generic is not appropriate. Commercially insured patients are not eligible for either program. Most Medicare beneficiaries qualify for a $0 to $10 generic copay instead and never need to apply.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta una estatina en Medicare en 2026?
es.answer: La atorvastatina y rosuvastatina genericas estan en el Nivel 1 o 2 de casi todos los formularios de Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage de 2026, con copagos de $0 a $10 por un suministro de 30 dias. Los beneficiarios de doble elegibilidad con Ayuda Extra pagan $0 a $4.90. Lipitor o Crestor de marca, si su plan aun los cubre, estan en un nivel superior con un copago mucho mas alto.

es.question: Hay un generico para Lipitor y Crestor?
es.answer: Si. La atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) esta disponible desde noviembre de 2011, y la rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) desde 2016. Mas de una docena de fabricantes aprobados por la FDA producen cada generico a partir de 2026. No existen biosimilares para ninguno de los dos porque son farmacos sinteticos de molecula pequena.

es.question: Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente para Lipitor o Crestor de marca?
es.answer: Para Lipitor, solicite a traves de Pfizer RxPathways en pfizerrxpathways.com o llame al 1-844-989-PATH (7284). Para Crestor, solicite a traves de AZ&Me en azandme.com o llame al 1-800-292-6363. Ambos aceptan a inscritos de Medicare Parte D y Medicare Advantage con ingresos al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza o menos.

es.question: Puedo usar un cupon del fabricante de Lipitor o Crestor con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe que los cupones de copago del fabricante sean usados por personas inscritas en Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. Si tiene Medicare, solicite Ayuda Extra a traves del Seguro Social o use el PAP basado en ingresos de Pfizer RxPathways o AZ&Me.

es.question: El precio negociado de la IRA aplica a las estatinas?
es.answer: No. Ni la atorvastatina ni la rosuvastatina fueron seleccionadas para la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, y ninguna tiene un Precio Justo Maximo para 2026. Las estatinas ya tienen competencia generica que mantiene los precios en $3 a $18 al mes, por lo que no fue necesaria la negociacion.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta una estatina sin seguro en el mostrador de la farmacia?
es.answer: La atorvastatina generica cuesta $3 a $9 al mes en Costco y Walmart sin seguro, y $10 a $25 en CVS o Walgreens con un cupon gratuito. La rosuvastatina generica cuesta $9 a $18 al mes en la mayoria de las cadenas con cupon. Lipitor y Crestor de marca se venden al por menor entre $300 y $700 al mes sin seguro.

es.question: Que hago si mi plan Medicare niega la cobertura de mi estatina?
es.answer: Las denegaciones de estatinas genericas en Medicare son raras porque casi todos los planes cubren al menos dos estatinas en el Nivel 1. Si se niega, solicite una determinacion de cobertura por escrito, luego pida a su medico que presente una excepcion de formulario. Si aun se niega, presente una redeterminacion de Nivel 1 dentro de 60 dias.

es.question: Califico para el programa de asistencia al paciente de Pfizer RxPathways o AZ&Me?
es.answer: Para calificar en 2026, sus ingresos familiares deben ser iguales o inferiores al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza: $47,880 para una persona, $99,000 para una familia de cuatro. Tambien necesita una receta valida de marca e inscripcion en Medicare Parte D o Medicare Advantage. La mayoria de los beneficiarios de Medicare califican para un copago generico de $0 a $10 en su lugar.
